items.title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings

motions.item_title: COR-TRY-26-017, 2026 Fall Debenture Issue - Council Delegation By-law
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo approve A By-law to Delegate Authority to the Outgoing Council to Pass By-law(s) to authorize the issue of Debentures for Capital Works of The Regional Municipality of Waterloo and of its Lower-tier Municipalities, as set out in report COR-TRY-26-017 dated June 2, 2026.
motions.text_html: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo approve A By-law to Delegate Authority to the Outgoing Council to Pass By-law(s) to authorize the issue of Debentures for Capital Works of The Regional Municipality of Waterloo and of its Lower-tier Municipalities, as set out in report COR-TRY-26-017 dated June 2, 2026.

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.

That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon twenty-year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $30,600,000 for Capital Works of The Corporation of the City of Cambridge, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 26-027, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon twenty-year instalment debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $30,600,000 for Capital Works of The Corporation of the City of Cambridge, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 26-027, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to Delegate Authority to the Outgoing Council to Pass By-law(s) to authorize the issue of Debentures for Capital Works of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo and of its Lower-tier Municipalities, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 26-028, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to Delegate Authority to the Outgoing Council to Pass By-law(s) to authorize the issue of Debentures for Capital Works of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo and of its Lower-tier Municipalities, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 26-028, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to Confirm the Proceedings of the Council of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo at this Meeting Held on June 2, 2026 be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 26-029, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
